newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 15.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Chang Wen-you, director of Criminal Investigation Bureau, visits Hong Kong with list of alleged gangsters who fled Taiwan's crackdown on organised crime.
Weng Hsiao-lun, vice president of state-owned Rester Engineering Agency, detained over allegations of bribery.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Defence Minister Chiang Chung-ling arrives in Austria today and later may visit Czech Republic.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Central bank says after board meeting it will mainatin stable-to-loose monetary policy.
Taiwan and United States hold talks on Taiwan's bid to enter World Trade Organisation.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Bank of Taiwan lowers prime lending rate by 0.025 percentage points to 7.025 percent.
Finance Ministry plans to issue T$50 billion in government bonds in December.
